unsupported_claims: 'Select **Not Connected**' as step 3 after Settings -> page selects Not Connected right after the time (Turn on Wi-Fi steps); the connect steps go Settings > Network
'your network name and signal strength show in the Wi-Fi panel' -> page names no Wi-Fi panel and says this only means you are already connected
reasons: Navigation path mixes two sections of the page; unsupported 'Wi-Fi panel' claim.
fix: Page path is: select the time at the bottom right, then Settings, then Network on the left, then pick the network, (type password), Connect. 'Not Connected' belongs to the separate 'Turn on Wi-Fi' steps and is selected right after selecting the time, not after Settings. Rewrite the path as: 1 Select the time at the bottom right. 2 Select Settings. 3 On the left, select Network. Then select the network, type the password, select Connect. If Wi-Fi is off: select the time, select Not Connected, turn on Wi-Fi. Remove 'your network name and signal strength show in the Wi-Fi panel' (the page only says that seeing the network name and signal strength after selecting Not Connected means you are already connected; it names no 'Wi-Fi panel').

Earlier turn: 'Select **Not Connected**' after Settings -> wrong path
reasons: The failure cause is an unsupported inference and the first assistant turn has the wrong Wi-Fi path; the page gives no troubleshooting for a missing network.
fix: Fix the first assistant turn path as in tr169-a. Change the user's second message to a story the page supports, e.g. 'My network name is not shown because the router is set to hide its name, but I know the name and password.' Then reply: 1 Select the time at the bottom right, then Settings. 2 Select Network on the left. 3 Select Add connection, then Add Wi-Fi. 4 Enter the network information in the box that appears. 5 Select Connect. Drop 'The network may be hidden' as a guess.
